verdict.rationale: Phaser exposes a documented programmatic JavaScript/TypeScript API: concept docs show calls like this.add.sprite, and full TypeScript definitions ship with the package. Its hosted Game Agent can also be driven through an official MCP server with 40+ tools, and phaser.io/llms.txt points to a REST examples endpoint. However, no OpenAPI spec exists, docs.phaser.io llms.txt and markdown docs return 404, the only REST surface shown covers examples rather than driving the product, and phaser.io returns 403 to non-browser clients. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API for driving the editor/agent services, an OpenAPI or other machine-readable API spec, machine-readable docs on docs.phaser.io, and unrestricted non-browser client access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Full TypeScript definitions can be found inside the types folder... modern editors such as VSCode will detect them automatically.
It implements over 40 specialised tools and integrates directly with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible tools.
For full metadata and source code, use the API: GET /api/v1/examples/{id}
